author: BeatingMeat
body:
Hello,

I got banned for 2 weeks for suicidal encouragement. This I feel is a mistake as I said ‘Kys’ in a jokily manner to my friend WhatLiesBeaneath. She did not take any offence nor did it effect her. So she knows and I know, it was a joke. (you can ask her if you want.) Therefore this is not suicidal encouragement as it was a joke. Also we were in walls and there were not many people in walls either and I knew all of them so they all knew it was a joke.

Thank you for reading my appeal.
Hoellister
